name: Waking Nightmare

startedBy.speaker: Brina Merilis
startedBy.prompt: I came at a bad time? What's wrong?
reply: Not a single man or woman in Dawnstar has gotten a good night's rest in days. We keep having the same nightmare, over and over.
If people aren't tired, they're angry, and if they aren't angry, they're afraid. It's made keeping order a mess.
I hear Mara has sent one of her priests to the inn to try to calm people down, but I don't know how much words will do now.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Brina Merilis

startedBy.speaker: Skald the Elder
reply: That's right. Dawnstar. My Dawnstar is plagued with nightmares. I haven't slept properly in days.
That priest of Mara who came here before you says the Divines will cure us.
Well, until they do, I don't have any business to discuss with outsiders.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Skald the Elder

startedBy.speaker: Madena
reply: You haven't heard? All of Dawnstar hasn't had a decent night's rest in days.
People are having nightmares they swear are real. They go to bed, but they wake up more tired than yesterday.
I've heard that a priest of Mara has come, saying that the Divines will lift this curse somehow, but that remains to be seen.
startedBy.conditions: GetInCell Skyrim.esm:013A80 == 1; Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Madena

startedBy.speaker: Rustleif
startedBy.prompt: No one's getting any rest? Why not?
reply: Nightmares. I haven't met a single man or woman who doesn't admit to having them.
A bad dream I can handle, but everyone having the same bad dream, every night? It's a curse, I say.
I hear there's a priest of Mara visiting the inn. Maybe the Divines will cure us.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Rustleif

startedBy.speaker: Leigelf
startedBy.prompt: Why aren't you getting much sleep?
reply: It's these nightmares. Me and every one of my workers can't catch a nod without having one.
They're almost... real. They say a priest of Mara has arrived in town. We'll see if faith can cure this curse.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Leigelf

startedBy.speaker: Frida
reply: New in town? Oh, you're lucky. Dreams aren't affecting travelers.
Everyone else though... They're horrible. Imagine dying over and over again in your dreams night after night.
They say a priest of Mara is visiting the Windpeak Inn. Says the Divines will take care of everything. We'll see about that.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Frida
startedBy.source: TIF__0008790D.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:08790D (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Beitild
reply: Everyone here is having nightmares. I have miners tripping over their own feet from lack of sleep.
I heard there was a Priest of Mara who was supposed to be looking into it. We'll see if anything comes of that.
startedBy.conditions: Waking Nightmare stage 10 not done; the speaker is Beitild

movedBy.speaker: Erandur
reply: Thank Mara. I was afraid I'd never be able to convince you.
Allow me to gather the materials I need for my ritual, and then I will meet you outside the ruins.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Erandur; Waking Nightmare stage >= 20; fn79 == 1

movedBy.speaker: Erandur
movedBy.prompt: I trust you. How can I help?
reply: Wonderful! My lady Mara will be quite pleased!
Nightcaller Temple is only a short walk from Dawnstar. Come, we must hurry.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Erandur; Waking Nightmare stage < 22

movedBy.speaker: Erandur
movedBy.prompt: I've decided to help you end the nightmares.
reply: Mara be praised!
Nightcaller Temple is only a short walk from Dawnstar. Come, we must hurry.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Erandur; Waking Nightmare stage == 22

movedBy.speaker: Erandur
reply: I understand. If you should change your mind, I'll be here.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Erandur; Waking Nightmare stage < 22

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
